title: Attacker Reportedly Used BOSSAI AI Agents to Extract Emergency Dispatch Records in Taipei, Taiwan
summary: According to Acronis researchers, a Taiwan-based attacker used a coordinated network of AI agents called BOSSAI to access an emergency-dispatch system in Taipei, Taiwan, and extract case records from seven city districts. The records included incident times, response types, status fields, and street-level locations. The researchers described the extraction as part of a wider AI-assisted cyberattack campaign.
